insight: Co-authored with Anthropic the OAuth authorization proposal accepted into the MCP spec; raised a $12M seed in 2025.
name: Arcade
tagline: The MCP runtime for secure, authenticated agent tool-calling.
description: A platform that lets AI agents take real, authenticated actions across business systems like Gmail, GitHub, Slack, and Notion. Arcade handles the hard part of agent tool-use — secure, per-user authorization — so a tool call runs with the actual end user's permissions rather than a shared API key. It ships agent-optimized prebuilt tools plus an open framework for building custom ones, exposed over MCP. A free tier is available for getting started.
edge: Auth-first MCP runtime: brokers per-user OAuth so an agent acts as the real end user, not behind one shared token.
pros: Real actions in Gmail, GitHub, Slack
